title: Senior Lecturer of Business Administration
bio: Overview I have several principal areas of research focus. As course head of the course founded by the late Clay Christensen, I continue to research the impact of disruptive innovation in both the for-profit and non-profit sectors, with a focus on the continuing difficulty of response for leading incumbent players, even now 30 years after the theory was first codified. I also help to lead theory and curriculum development with a group of Harvard colleagues on the concept of spiritually-grounded leadership, compiling the academic literature in the field and developing case studies of exemplars for student examination. Keywords: Disruptive Innovation ; Culture ; Strategic Planning ; Strategy ; Leadership ; India ; Europe ; Asia
research_interests: disruptive technology ethics growth management leadership development values
